ei.title: Children's Taste Preferences and Early Food Experiences
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Science shows that, when compared to adults, children naturally prefer higher levels of sweet and salty tastes and reject bitter tastes. This might help explain why children are drawn to more unhealthy food choices within our current food environment — an environment composed of high-salt, high-refined-sugar foods. In support of this idea, studies have found that sensory experiences, beginning early in life, can shape preferences in both a positive and a negative way. For example, expecting mothers who consume diets rich in healthy foods can help develop their child's taste preferences in a positive way because flavors from foods that the mother eats are transmitted to amniotic fluid and to mother's milk, creating an environment in which breastfed infants are more accepting of these flavors. In contrast, infants fed formula learn to prefer its unique flavor profile and may have more difficulty initially accepting flavors not found in formula, such as those of fruit and vegetables. Having healthy food experiences early in life may go a long way toward promoting healthy eating throughout a person's life span.

✅ ① indifferent: 아이들이 건강에 해로운 음식에 '무관심하다'는 것은 '끌린다(drawn)'는 원문과 모순 ←정답

questions.passage: For example, expecting mothers who consume diets rich in healthy foods can help develop their child's taste preferences in a positive way because flavors from foods that the mother eats are __________ (transmit) to amniotic fluid and to mother's milk.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: are + 과거분사 = 수동태. 맛이 양수와 모유에 전달'되는' 것이므로 수동태 are transmitted가 필요. 동사 transmit의 과거분사형 transmitted로 변환
det.tip: transmit(동사: 전달하다) → transmitted(과거분사: 전달되는) / are transmitted = 수동태

questions.passage: In contrast, infants fed formula learn to prefer its unique flavor profile and may have more difficulty __________ (initial) accepting flavors not found in formula.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동명사 accepting을 수식하는 부사가 필요. 형용사 initial에 -ly를 붙여 부사 initially(처음에)로 변환. have difficulty (in) initially accepting = 처음에 받아들이는 데 어려움을 겪다

questions.passage: Science shows that, when compared to adults, children naturally prefer higher levels of sweet and salty tastes and reject bitter tastes. This might help explain why children are drawn to more unhealthy food choices within our current food environment — an environment composed of high-salt, high-refined-sugar foods. In support of this idea, studies have found that sensory experiences, beginning early in life, can shape preferences __________. For example, expecting mothers who consume diets rich in healthy foods can help develop their child's taste preferences in a positive way because flavors from foods that the mother eats are transmitted to amniotic fluid and to mother's milk, creating an environment in which breastfed infants are more accepting of these flavors. In contrast, infants fed formula learn to prefer its unique flavor profile and may have more difficulty initially accepting flavors not found in formula, such as those of fruit and vegetables. Having healthy food experiences early in life may go a long way toward promoting healthy eating throughout a person's life span.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 감각 경험이 선호를 ____ 형성할 수 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① only in a negative: '부정적이고 비가역적으로만'은 긍정적 방식도 포함하는 원문과 불일치
✅ ② in both a positive and a negative way: 원문에서 '긍정적이고 부정적인 양쪽 방식으로' 형성한다고 기술 ←정답
❌ ③ exclusively through genetic: '유전으로만'은 감각 경험에 의한 형성이라는 원문과 반대
❌ ④ in a way that cannot be measured: '측정할 수 없는 방식으로'는 원문에 없음
det.tip: in both a positive and a negative way = 긍정적이고 부정적인 양쪽 방식으로

ch: only in a negative and irreversible manner
in both a positive and a negative way
in a way that cannot be measured

questions.passage: Science shows that, when compared to adults, children naturally prefer higher levels of sweet and salty tastes and reject bitter tastes. This might help explain why children are drawn to more unhealthy food choices within our current food environment — an environment composed of high-salt, high-refined-sugar foods. In support of this idea, studies have found that sensory experiences, beginning early in life, can shape preferences in both a positive and a negative way. For example, expecting mothers who consume diets rich in healthy foods can help develop their child's taste preferences in a positive way because flavors from foods that the mother eats are transmitted to amniotic fluid and to mother's milk, creating an environment in which breastfed infants are more accepting of these flavors. In contrast, infants fed formula learn to prefer its unique flavor profile and may have more difficulty initially accepting flavors not found in formula, such as those of fruit and vegetables. Having healthy food experiences early in life may __________ promoting healthy eating throughout a person's life span.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어릴 때 건강한 음식 경험은 평생 건강한 식습관을 촉진하는 데 ____
det.analysis:
❌ ① have little impact on: '거의 영향이 없다'는 긍정적 효과를 말하는 원문과 반대
❌ ② completely guarantee: '완전히 보장하다'는 원문보다 과도한 표현
✅ ③ go a long way toward: '~하는 데 크게 기여하다'는 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ have no connection to: '~와 관련이 없다'는 원문과 반대
det.tip: go a long way toward = ~하는 데 크게 기여하다/큰 도움이 되다
